risk_summary: The disclosure is detailed and substantially quantified, including organizational changes, reinsurance arrangements, ownership, and multi-year combined ratios. Risk remains centered on reserve estimation uncertainty, litigation and regulatory expansion of coverage, adverse commercial automobile results, and complex affiliate pooling structures. Overall tone is cautiously constructive, reflecting improving 2020 underwriting performance but continuing exposure to material insurance liabilities.
